heading: Governing bodies of schools
title: Governing bodies of schools
text:
9. Governing bodies of schools.___(1) The Authority shall establish such number of Danish Schools under the provisions of this Act as it may deem appropriate and it may, by notification in the official Gazette, declare any school as Daanish School in the manner prescribed by rules.
(2) The Authority shall constitute and appoint a governing body for every Danish School to serve for a term of two years in the manner prescribed by regulation. All members of the governing body shall be from the concerned Province, preferably from the local area and shall serve on a pro bono basis.
(3) The governing body shall consist of five or more members who, in the opinion of the Authority, possess sound moral and financial integrity, enjoy an unquestioned and non-controversial reputation and do not have any conflict of interest with the aims and objects of the Daanish School.
(4) The Authority shall nominate one of the members of the governing body as convener of the governing body.
(5) The Principal of the concerned Daanish School shall be the secretary of the governing body of that School.
(6) No person shall be appointed as member of more than two governing bodies.
(7) The Authority may delegate administrative and financial powers of a Daanish School to its governing body in the manner prescribed by regulations.
(8) The Authority may, for reasons to be recorded in writing, dissolve a governing body and appoint a new governing body within three months of such dissolution.
(9) If the Authority dissolves a governing body, it may appoint any person as administrator of that Daanish School to look after the affairs of the School till the appointment of the governing body.

heading: Admission to Daanish School
title: Admission to Daanish School
text:
10. Admission to Daanish School. ___ (1) The governing body shall ensure that admissions in the Daanish School shall be merit-based and only ten percent of total seats of students shall pay such fee and other expenses as may be prescribed by regulations.
(2) Subject to sub-section (1), the Governing Body shall admit destitute children, in order of precedence, under any of the following categories, namely: ___
(a) orphan having lost both of his parents and having no guardian;
(b) orphan and living with real parent; and
(c) both parents are alive but are illiterate and do not own immoveable property and either of them is disabled and have no source of income.

(4) The governing body may admit a student whose one of the parent is an employee of the Daanish School.
(5) The governing body shall determine the merit for the admission in the school on the basis of criteria prescribed by regulations.
(6) The Authority may, for the reasons to be recorded in writing, alter or set-aside any decision of the governing body if it finds that the decision is not based on the criteria for admission.

heading: Fund
title: Fund
raw_text:
12. Fund.___(1) There shall be established a fund to be known as the Daanish Schools Authority 
Fund which shall vest in the Authority and shall be utilized by the Authority for the purpose of this Act, 
and to meet charges and expenditures in connection with its functions including salaries and other 
remuneration of the Managing Director, members, officers, staff, experts and consultants of the 
Authority. 
(2) The fund shall be kept in such custody and shall be utilized and regulated in such manner as 
may be prescribed by rules. 
(3) The Fund shall be consist of,  
(a)  
grants made by the Government; 
(b)  
funds provided by the Federal and provincial government; 
(c)  
loans and grants from the national or international agencies received by the 
Authority to finance the functions of the Authority; 
(d)  
charges and fees collected by such sources as may be  
approved by the Authority; 
(e)  
income from investments and deposits as approved by the Authority and in 
accordance with rules; 
(f)  
income from the sale of movable or immovable property; and 
(g)  
donations and endowments.

heading: Transfer of government employees
title: Transfer of government employees
text:
18. Transfer of government employees.___(1) The Government may, with the concurrence of the Authority, transfer the services of any of its employees to the Authority.
(2) The Authority may, with the concurrence of an employee and the Government, absorb or induct the services of the employee into its service.
(3) The terms and conditions of the services of an employee transferred from the Government or absorbed in the service of the Authority shall be such as may be prescribed.
